descriptionChirho: Anxious concern or preoccupying worry about life circumstances, whether worldly cares that choke the word (Matt 13:22; Mark 4:19; Luke 8:14; 21:34), the care of the churches weighing on an apostle (2 Cor 11:28), or the general anxiety one is urged to cast upon God (1 Pet 5:7). All multilingual glosses converge: Arabic hamm/ihtimam, German Sorge, French souci, Hebrew de'agah, Hindi chinta, Korean geokjeong/yeomryeo, Spanish preocupacion/afan.
